reauth_confirm.title: Fogos.pt API key

districts.title: Districts
districts.description: Choose one or more districts (islands are listed as districts). Leave empty to follow the whole country.

concelhos.title: Municipalities
concelhos.description: Optionally narrow down to municipalities. A district without chosen municipalities is followed entirely.

freguesias.title: Parishes
freguesias.description: Optionally narrow down to parishes. A municipality without chosen parishes is followed entirely.

warnings.title: IPMA warning areas
warnings.description: Weather warning areas to follow (suggested from your locations; Madeira and the Azores included).

data.radius: Earthquakes: maximum distance from home (0 = any)
data.seismic_near_selection: Earthquakes: only near the chosen locations
